The first week sets the pattern. Pick three repeat jobs, write one brief for each, review the first results and save your feedback as a checklist. The onboarding checklist has the full list.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-onboarding-checklist?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=on1-week1

Most delegation problems are brief problems. A short brief with the goal, the steps, an example and the deadline gets better work than a long call. There is a free fill-in template.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/how-to-write-a-task-brief?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=tb1-brief

AI is fast at drafts, lists and first passes. A person decides what is right for your business. The guide compares a virtual assistant and an AI assistant task by task, including where AI alone is the better pick.

https://myremoteva.com/blog/virtual-assistant-vs-ai-assistant?utm_source=linkedin&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ai1-human
